name: io.github.thalisantunes/govbr-apis-mcp
title: gov.br APIs MCP
description: Brazilian government APIs through a spec-driven gateway over a YAML catalog.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPARENCIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the Portal da Transparencia API

environmentVariables.name: DATAJUD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the CNJ DataJud API

environmentVariables.name: DADOSGOV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the dados.gov.br portal API (free, generated in the user profile)

environmentVariables.name: SERPRO_CPF_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client ID for the Serpro CPF API (commercial contract)

environmentVariables.name: SERPRO_CPF_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret for the Serpro CPF API (commercial contract)

environmentVariables.name: SERPRO_CNPJ_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client ID for the Serpro CNPJ API (commercial contract)

environmentVariables.name: SERPRO_CNPJ_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret for the Serpro CNPJ API (commercial contract)

environmentVariables.name: SERPRO_DATAVALID_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client ID for the Serpro Datavalid API (commercial contract)

environmentVariables.name: SERPRO_DATAVALID_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret for the Serpro Datavalid API (commercial contract)

environmentVariables.name: MEIAENTRADA_CODIGO_ACESSO
environmentVariables.description: Access code (codigoAcesso) for the CIE validator used for meia-entrada, issued to the venue or producer
